name: Informetis Co.,Ltd.
summary: Informetis Co., Ltd. engages in the energy informatics business in Japan. It offers ienowa and enenova for reducing the use of electricity by home appliances, generating electricity from solar power, and store electricity; and hitonowa, an energy management service for electric power companies. Informetis Co., Ltd. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
